declarations.name: AuiStepper

inputs.name: label
inputs.description: Accessible name of the <nav> (aria-label), e.g. "Checkout progress". Must not be empty.

inputs.name: steps
inputs.description: Steps in order (at least one). Ids must be unique and non-empty; labels must be non-empty. status is consumer-owned; href renders a reachable step as a link.

inputs.name: orientation
inputs.description: Layout. A horizontal stepper renders vertically when its container is 30rem wide or narrower.

inputs.name: linear
inputs.description: When true, a step after the current one is reachable only when every step before it has status 'complete'. Earlier steps are always reachable unless disabled.

inputs.name: direction
inputs.description: 'rtl' sets dir="rtl" on the <nav>; 'ltr' leaves the document direction in effect.

inputs.name: icons
inputs.description: Icon slot overrides for the step indicator.

models.name: value
models.description: Current step id. Must be the id of an existing step.

outputs.name: navigate
outputs.description: The user activated a reachable step (unmodified primary click, Enter, or Space on a button). preventDefault keeps the current step and stops link navigation.

outputs.name: changed
outputs.description: The current step changed after an uncanceled aui-navigate.

methods.name: state
methods.description: Resolved state ('current' | 'complete' | 'error' | 'upcoming') of a step, or null for an unknown id.

methods.name: isReachable
methods.description: Whether the user can activate the step in the current state. False for the current step, disabled steps, and unknown ids.

methods.name: select
methods.description: Make a step current programmatically. No events and no reachability check. Throws STEPPER_OPTIONS for an unknown id.

accessibility.pattern: Navigation landmark with an ordered list of steps (progress indicator). Reachable steps are native links or buttons; the current step is marked with aria-current="step". Not a tablist.

limitations: Every change (activation, select, update, global configuration) rebuilds the step list; a step that had focus during update() or a configuration change loses focus.
After a link step is activated without preventDefault, focus is not moved; the page is expected to navigate.
The layout switch from horizontal to vertical is fixed at a 30rem container width.
No arrow-key navigation between steps; steps are separate Tab stops.
Step content (panels) is not rendered by the stepper; drive it from aui-change.
